message.body:

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything.

Our present Angebot is a price of €47.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint.

As an option, we can do the 1500 ppm target you asked for, but we need 46.50 EUR for it. This package offers a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint.

You talked about punctual payment, but honestly you guys have been paying late recently, so we really need you to pay on time. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
